newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bergesen sees better '97 for gas, tankers.
newsitem.headline: Bergesen sees better '97 for gas, tankers.

text.p: Norway's largest shipping company Bergesen d.y. Group said on Thursday it expected an improved full-year result for its gas carriers and tanker divisions than in 1996.
For the dry bulk sector, it forecast a result in line with 1996.
Bergesen posted a first quarter operating profit up 21 percent at 228 million crowns and a pre-tax result of 185 million crowns against 221 million crowns a year ago.
"Based on the first quarter results the conditions favour somewhat improved profit for the gas carriers in 1997 as against 1996," the company said in a statement.
"However it is expected a weaker market throughout the summer, while the prospects for the autumn look good."
The company added that tankers were expected to show an improvement for the year 1997 compared with 1996.
